summary: OpenAI published a case study describing how legal-tech company Legora used GPT-6 Astra to review 41 financial documents and identify planted errors with a stated performance improvement.

practices.reason: The customer's planted-error test is a measurement approach but it is described only as an internal case-study result, not a transferable benchmark.
practices.quote: find all four planted errors, and improve performance by nearly 40% in this financial-review workflow
